thread:
Nora (CS): quick weekly check-in for CoinRidge — commit is 50k tokens/mo, we're seeing 73k this week, flagged as +46% over commit. noticing higher error rate on chat endpoints too. any immediate asks?
Sam (Billing): saw the alert this morning :warning: billing-bot pushed a high-usage signal at 07:12 UTC. auto-threshold is 30% over commit.
billing-bot: [ALERT] customer=coinridge, metric=hosted_tokens, window=24h, actual=73,254, commit=50,000, pct_over=46.51%, severity=warning
Nora (CS): copying usage breakdown now — top callers are `/api/v1/generate` and `/api/v1/embeddings` from CoinRidge-prod. embeddings specifically spiked after Monday.
Jin (SE): can you paste the sample query counts? thinking if it's a batch rerun or real-time traffic.
Nora (CS): quick paste: `top_endpoints: /generate=41k tokens, /embeddings=27k tokens`  — embeddings calls average sequence length x4 normal.
Tom (Eng): interesting — we had a model variant rollout last week that increased default context window for the chat-lite model. could be that their SDK picked up the new model id.
Jin (SE): action item: ask CoinRidge if they kicked off any bulk retraining/embedding jobs. if yes, suggest rate-limiting or segmented batches.
Sam (Billing): from a short-term ops perspective we can offer a 1-week temporary quota bump and waive overage for the first 20% if they commit to a remediation plan. approve? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:?
Nora (CS): I'm going to call their technical PM @coinridge-ops in 30m. will request details and ask them to pause any scheduled backfills. also propose a call to review best practices for prefix caching and batching.
Tom (Eng): if they confirm it was the new model id, we can add a compatibility note to the release and an opt-in flag so clients don't auto-switch.
Jin (SE): also recommend they switch embeddings to streaming chunked uploads to reduce peak memory/sequence length.
Sam (Billing): logged a note on their account: `waive_overage_proposal=20pct_for_1_week`, `requires_cs_followup=yes`.
Nora (CS): next steps: 1) call coinridge-ops (30m), 2) pause batch jobs if present, 3) temp quota & waiver, 4) update release notes if client picked new model. I'll update this thread after the call.
Nora (CS): post-call update — they ran a one-off migration job (embeddings backfill) and missed the recommended batch window. agreed to pause rest of the backfill and rerun in staggered batches. they accepted the temporary quota and waiver.
Sam (Billing): thanks — marking the alert resolved in the billing dashboard and keeping the waiver ticket open until next weekly check.
Tom (Eng): filing a small follow-up ticket to add an opt-in switch for the model rollout + a short doc blurb.
Nora (CS): closing loop here. will follow up in next weekly health check with actual delta. :white_check_mark:
